title: [Bug] Tab Key Incorrectly Triggers Thinking Instead of File Completion
body:
**Bug Description**
Pressing tab toggles the thinking instead of tabbing through files that exist on disk. I used tabbing on files a lot. This is rather annoying in version 2.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vte-based
- Version: 2.0.0
- Feedback ID: f6bfdc68-5db4-449f-b64b-e22f81485aac
author: KJ7LNW

top_comments.author: emcd
top_comments.body: Agreed. It is better than the [`/t` toggle](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/7717) that existed prior to version 2.0.0. And, tab completion does not seem to toggle thinking if you use it inside an `@`-reference. But, as I [noted](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/7717#issuecomment-3349528025) in the `/t` issue, there is a good reason to want tab completion to work outside of `@`-references: namely, to make Claude explicitly read a file before using an edit tool on

top_comments.author: KJ7LNW
top_comments.body:
> there is a good reason to want tab completion to work outside of @-references

INDEED! I do not wish to dump file content in, I just need to tell it about something that it can inspect later.

top_comments.author: jack-zihan
top_comments.body: agree and wait to bring tab completion back!
